title: GLFW Windowing
concept: GLFW bindings for XIOM — create windows, handle input, and manage OpenGL/Vulkan contexts for cross-platform graphics applications.
why: Every graphics application needs a window. GLFW provides a simple, cross-platform windowing library that works with both OpenGL and Vulkan.
tips: Always pair glfw::init() with glfw::terminate() — use RAII if possible
Delta time is critical for physics — use glfw::get_time() for frame-independent updates
Window hints MUST be set BEFORE creating the window — they can't be changed after
Use glfw::poll_events() every frame — the window becomes unresponsive without it
common_mistakes: Forgetting to call swap_buffers() — the screen never updates
Not handling window resize — the viewport gets stretched
Calling OpenGL functions before make_context_current() — crashes with null context
